newsitem.title: UNITED NATIONS: U.N. assembly pays tribute to late Danish envoy.
newsitem.headline: U.N. assembly pays tribute to late Danish envoy.

text.p: The General Assembly observed a minute of silence Friday in memory of Denmark's late U.N. representative, ambassador Benny Kimberg, who died last Sunday of cancer aged 58.
Tributes were also delivered by representatives of U.N. regional groups and of the United States, the host country. Danish deputy U.N. representative Theis Truelsen responded.
Kimberg took up his U.N. post in August 1995 after serving four years as ambassador to France.

A native of Horsens, Denmark, he joined his country's foreign service in 1964. He was ambassador to Japan from 1984 to 1986 and permanent under-secretary of state for political affairs from 1986 to 1991.
